title: GitLab security advisory (AV26-962)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-962 Date: September 25, 2026 As of September 23, 2026, GitLab is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: GitLab Prior to 19.2.7 Prior to 19.3.3 Prior to 19.4.1 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. GitLab Critical Patch Release: 19.4.1, 19.3.3, 19.2.7 GitLab release notes | GitLab Docs Article Link: GitLab security advisory (AV26-962) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
